comment: Material is easy but you have to take great notes since you'll be basically teaching yourself; there's no homework, only one quiz per week, and almost no uploaded resources. Class was online or cancelled more than half the time leading up to the midterm which few people did well on. Makes you wonder why he has the job he does if he cares so little

No homework or practice outside of class, quizzes every other week, and lectures during class based off slides posted. Having such a lack of practice material made it really hard to prepare for the exams (only a few practice problems for each topic, and they were easy). The quizzes were easy and just like the slides, but the exams were difficult.

This class wasn't good. Half of the class was online, and then for the first midterm, he made the content a lot harder than anything we've done, and then didn't curve it even though no one did well. Quizzes are worth a lot, but are somewhat easy. He is very specific about what the correct answers are, be aware. Didn't know my grade until the end.
Not the best teacher, but extremely easy class. Binish is also a very nice person, and is willing to help you whenever needed.

Really chill class. There are quizzes every week but it's the same material covered in class. Midterms were easy too considering they were similar to the practice problems he gave. Really liked never having HW.
Very easy class if you have taken stats before. Both tests are very manageable if you study. Quizzes are also pretty easy and are very short. One quiz is dropped and the final was take home.

I enjoyed his BSTAT class a lot, I just didn't like how all the tests are weighted the same (15%) because I found myself improving as the semester went on but my grade didn't really reflect it. Other than that the quizzes matter a lot but they are short and easy if you take notes in class.

Lets you use cheat sheets on tests and quizzes, which is awesome. His lectures are clear and he uploads the PowerPoints to Blackboard so you can refer back to them. Not super personable, but he is very fair

Very caring and nice guy. Graded on many things, with the biggest being the final, which was worth 15%. Clearly explains topics in the lectures, although they can be a little challenging to understand at first, but that's just statistics. I hope I have the opportunity to take him again.

He's a great guy, and honestly cares about his students. Lot's of group work, take home quizzes, and a suprise at the end of the semsester that you will be thankful for. Honestly made me interested in data science and analytics. Lectures are very boring but that's just the nature of the content.
His tests and quizzes are easy as long as you do the practice problems (which are the same as exam problems with different numbers). Assignments are hard but not graded too tough.

Genuinely nice professor and very accessible outside of class but his class was extremely redundant, and hard to follow. That may be due to the nature of a statistics class but it was generally a waste of time. Three big assignments which each make up 10% of your grade but you get almost no guidance on how to do them which was extremely stressful.

Great guy; extremely nice and caring and clearly passionate about his subject field. Lectures are essentially just a repeat of the textbook content, which you will need to reference religiously to succeed. Excel is not taught in this course but you will be expected to know it, though. Easy B, but you will have to work hard for an A.
